outputs.summary: Retry-2 network error capture and unique response-candidate checks are present, and all three generated inventory tests are discoverable. Execution cannot begin because the approved separately displayed product-count assertions remain uncovered.

validation.result: PASS: six tests discovered across two files, including all three approved inventory cases. No tests were executed.

findings.finding: The approved expected results require a separately displayed product count. The automation only asserts that the number of rendered inventory cards equals the number of matched response records; it does not locate or assert visible count text.
findings.required_action: Provide UI evidence identifying the actual visible inventory-count element and a stable locator, or clarify/change the approved requirement and test cases if no separate count is intended. Then regenerate or update automation to assert the approved behavior.

errors: Approved displayed-product-count assertions in TC-001, TC-002, and TC-003 are not testable from the available UI evidence. This requires UI clarification/evidence or requirement and test-case clarification; rendered-card/response-record equality is not a substitute.
next_recommendation: Obtain requirement clarification or UI evidence for the separately displayed inventory count, update the approved cases or automation accordingly, and rerun automation review before execution.
